description: This bar chart illustrates the average JGA Score for two models, labeled “T5-small” (yellow bars) and an unlabeled orange model (likely the baseline or distilled model), across 27 consecutive turns, indexed by Turn ID along the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 26. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays two bars per Turn ID, with the orange bar consistently taller than the yellow bar for all turns. At Turn 0, the orange bar reaches approximately 0.97 and the yellow bar is slightly lower at around 0.96. The orange bars generally decrease in height over time, ending at Turn 26 with a value of approximately 0.45, while the yellow bars also decrease, ending at Turn 26 with a value of approximately 0.33. The bars are not sorted and are presented in chronological order by Turn ID. A legend in the upper right corner identifies the orange bars as belonging to the model labeled “T5-small,” which appears to be an error since “T5-small” is the label for the yellow bars according to the legend’s color coding.
